summaries.class_summary: DevicesMFE is a UI page class that extends HPXFlow and provides verification methods for the HP devices micro-frontend (MFE) interface. It contains methods to verify various UI elements and states related to device management, including popups, navigation bars, printer information, supply levels, and device cards.

methods.description: Verifies the presence of the new HP app popup skip button

method_input_parameters.name: raise_e
method_input_parameters.purpose: Flag to determine whether to raise an exception if element is not found

methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement object for the new HP app popup skip button or None
methods.method_purpose: Waits for and returns the new HP app popup skip button element to verify the popup is displayed
